slides.headline: October 14, 2010: India finished 2nd on a Commonwealth Games medal table for the first time ever.
The Delhi Commonwealth Games closed with India in 2nd place overall
slides.body: India finished with 38 gold medals and 101 medals in total, moving ahead of England for the first time in the event's history - achieved on home soil, at a Games India itself had built the venues for.

slides.headline: The gold that clinched 2nd place came on the very last day.
slides.body: Saina Nehwal saved a match point in the women's badminton singles final to beat Malaysia's Wong Mew Choo, pushing India's gold count past England's at the closing bell.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat needs the capacity to host the world, not just compete in it.
slides.body: Finishing 2nd at a Games it organized showed India could build the venues, run the logistics and still perform - hosting capability and athletic capability arriving together.

sources.text: Al Jazeera - Commonwealth Games end in New Delhi
